name: ObjectivesTaskStates
summary: The `taskStates` member body of the Objectives replicated state: a prefix-varint delta count, the client's delta-count-zero branch (a strict zero-or-one presence flag and, when it is one, a prefix varint), then a prefix-varint snapshot count and that many `codec.objectives-task-state` elements. Only the delta-count 0 branch has an instance in the recorded bundles, so the card pins the count to 0 and a non-zero count is refused rather than guessed.
purpose: Name the member layout that a two-level presence mask selects (in-group member 4 of group 1 of codec.objectives-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint delta count read by 0x143a69710. It is 0 in the measured body; the client's non-zero branch has no instance in the recorded bundles, so the card bounds it to 0 and the codec refuses anything else instead of inventing the layout.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The delta-count-zero branch of FUN_143a69fe0: a strict zero-or-one presence byte read by 0x1461adf60 (which rejects any byte above 1) followed, when it is 1, by one prefix varint. Measured 01 07.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: The prefix-varint snapshot count and that many 18-byte elements. Forty-three in the measured body.

evidence.ref: research/fixtures/wire/state-fragment-3857.hex: 00 01 07 2b then 43 x 18 bytes; the body re-encodes byte-exactly through the generated codec, including the delta flag.
Member reader 0x143a69710 and its zero branch FUN_143a69fe0 (build 30fe6461).
